custody_model: 420Vault VAULT_TREASURY; Treasury contracts are budget/disbursement control plane, not independent custody
governance_model: budget creation, scheduling and cancellation are GovernanceTimelock/Civic-controlled; execution is narrowly capability-scoped per disbursement
invariants: TREASURY-INV-001: no Treasury contract creates a parallel asset-custody path around 420Vault
TREASURY-INV-002: budgets require an explicit Civic action commitment and bounded validity window
TREASURY-INV-003: scheduled disbursements must bind exactly to the parent budget Civic action hash
TREASURY-INV-004: disbursement IDs are canonical and replay-safe
TREASURY-INV-005: executed <= committed <= ceiling; committed includes executed expenditure
TREASURY-INV-006: asset policy enforces single-disbursement and epoch caps
TREASURY-INV-007: execution is default-deny and capability-scoped to the exact disbursement
TREASURY-INV-008: execution is impossible before notBefore or after expiry
TREASURY-INV-009: cancellation releases unexecuted budget commitment and cannot revive terminal disbursements
TREASURY-INV-010: execution records a nonzero Vault release commitment for public auditability

vault_release_evidence_model.executor_trust_assumption: An executor already authorized for the exact disbursement submits a nonzero commitment derived from the actual Vault release evidence. Treasury records that commitment but does not cryptographically verify the Vault release.
vault_release_evidence_model.consumer_rule: EXECUTED plus nonzero vaultReleaseHash is Treasury completion evidence, not independent cryptographic proof of a Vault transfer. Live qualification must correlate the commitment to the actual 420Vault release evidence.

asset_representation.token: ERC20 contract address; exact integer token base units using the token's decimals for presentation only
asset_representation.admission: All assets including native require explicit governance policy allowlisting; zero is not a wildcard.
asset_representation.vault_identity: Budget vaultId is the registered instance ID, distinct from the VAULT_TREASURY type ID.
asset_representation.funding: Budget commitment is spending authority, not a reservation of Vault free balance. Resolve the exact registered vault and check free balance before release.
